skill.name: google-analytics-automation
skill.description: Automate Google Analytics 4 reporting through Rube MCP, including account discovery, standard reports, batch reports, pivots, funnels, and key event listings.
skill.summary: Query and analyze authorized Google Analytics 4 properties through Rube MCP.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All 60 command-execution alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks and code fences. The skill makes an expected third-party MCP connection and delegates Google OAuth through Rube.

remediation.issue: The setup delegates Google OAuth and analytics access to a third-party MCP service.
remediation.suggestion: Explain requested OAuth scopes, data handling, retention, and revocation steps before users authorize the Rube connection.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Google Analytics connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `google_analytics`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
- `dateRanges`: Array of date range objects with `startDate` and `endDate`
- `dimensions`: Array of dimension objects with `name` field
- `metrics`: Array of metric objects with `name` field
- `offset` is for result pagination, not date pagination
- `requests`: Array of individual report request objects (same structure as RUN_REPORT)
- `dimensions`: All dimensions used in any pivot
- `pivots`: Array of pivot definitions with `fieldNames`, `limit`, and `orderBys`
- Dimensions used in pivots must also be listed in top-level `dimensions`
- Pivot `fieldNames` reference dimension names from the top-level list
- Each pivot has its own independent `limit` and `orderBys`
- `funnelBreakdown`: Optional dimension to break down funnel by
2. `GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_LIST_KEY_EVENTS` - List all key events for the property [Required]
- Reports: Use `offset` and `limit` for row pagination
- Continue until `pageToken` is absent or `rowCount` reached
- Report data is nested in `rows` array with `dimensionValues` and `metricValues`
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- Use GET_METADATA to discover valid dimension and metric names

content.value_statement: Manual GA4 reporting requires repeated property discovery, schema checks, and pagination. This skill guides Rube MCP through reliable reporting and analysis workflows.
actual_capabilities: Lists accessible Google Analytics accounts and properties.
Runs standard GA4 reports with dimensions, metrics, filters, sorting, and pagination.
Runs up to five reports for one property in a batch.
Builds pivot reports with explicit dimensions and pivot definitions.
Runs ordered funnel reports with optional breakdown dimensions.
Lists configured key events for an authorized property.
limitations: Requires a configured Rube MCP server and an active Google Analytics connection.
Only accesses accounts and properties allowed by the connected Google identity.
Does not guarantee that every dimension and metric combination is compatible.
Today's analytics data may be incomplete because Google Analytics processing can be delayed.

use_cases.title: Monitor Marketing Performance
use_cases.description: Compare sessions, users, and revenue by source or campaign across a selected date range.

use_cases.title: Review Product Funnels
use_cases.description: Measure ordered user steps and identify conversion drop-off by device or another supported breakdown.

use_cases.title: Automate Client Reporting
use_cases.description: Run several recurring reports for one client property and summarize the returned metrics.

prompt_templates.title: List My GA4 Properties
prompt_templates.prompt: List my accessible Google Analytics accounts and properties. Show each display name with its full resource identifier.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Traffic Report
prompt_templates.prompt: For property [property], report sessions and active users by date for [date range]. Check compatibility and return every page.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Acquisition Segments
prompt_templates.prompt: For property [property], compare sessions, conversions, and revenue by source, medium, and device for [date range]. Sort by sessions.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Conversion Funnel
prompt_templates.prompt: For property [property], build a closed funnel for [steps] during [date range]. Break results down by device and explain major drop-offs.

output_examples.input: List the properties available under my primary Google Analytics account.
Report sessions and active users by device for the last seven complete days.
output_examples.output: Mobile led with 18,420 sessions and 14,870 active users. Desktop recorded 7,930 sessions, while tablet recorded 620.

output_examples.input: Analyze the view-item, add-to-cart, and purchase funnel by device.
output_examples.output: Mobile had the largest audience but the steepest add-to-cart loss. Desktop retained more users between cart and purchase.

best_practices: Search available tools first because MCP schemas can change.
Resolve and confirm the full property resource identifier before running reports.
Check dimension and metric compatibility before complex reports or batches.
anti_patterns: Do not use a numeric property identifier without the properties prefix.
Do not assume an empty report always includes a rows field.
Do not request large unpaginated result sets or ignore returned page tokens.

faq.question: What connection does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires Rube MCP and an active Google Analytics connection authorized through Google OAuth.

faq.question: Can it access every Google Analytics property?
faq.answer: No. It can access only properties permitted for the connected Google identity.

faq.question: Does it support GA4 standard reports?
faq.answer: Yes. It can request supported dimensions, metrics, filters, sorting, date ranges, limits, and offsets.

faq.question: Can it run several reports together?
faq.answer: Yes. A batch can contain up to five report requests for the same property.

faq.question: How does it handle incompatible metrics and dimensions?
faq.answer: It can retrieve property metadata and check compatibility before submitting a report.

faq.question: Does it change key event configuration?
faq.answer: The documented workflow lists existing key events. It does not document creating, updating, or deleting them.
